column1: #Contamination screen: canonical 31-mers of the reads, selected by hash at each reference's scale (1 in 1 to 2048 k-mers, about 4000 per reference), looked up in the same selection of the reference. Found: share of the reads' k-mers present in the reference (at its scale); only: present in this reference and no other of the panel (at the common scale 1 in 2048). Sequencing errors lower all shares, as a k-mer with an error is found nowhere.
